subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a portable message-presentation multi-select API, and which channel/fallback guarantees should its first version make?
rationale: The request introduces a new public SDK and channel contract; source evidence identifies no existing canonical API, while native platform capabilities differ enough that implementation cannot safely choose semantics on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Sponsor a portable contract
options.body: Define an additive multi-select block, selected-values callback schema, explicit fallback behavior, and initial supported channels before implementation.

options.title: Keep it channel-owned
options.body: Decline a portable message-tool contract and direct individual native interaction capabilities to the relevant channel plugins.

options.title: Defer pending interactive-workflow design
options.body: Leave the request open until the shared structured-input direction, including Slack modal work, has an approved owner and scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a portable contract
recommendation.body: Define an additive multi-select block, selected-values callback schema, explicit fallback behavior, and initial supported channels before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The provided feature-history evidence connects this person to the shared presentation, SDK, documentation, and renderer contract that the decision would alter.
